title: Enchant
description: Enchantflex is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows you to control the maximum levels of enchantments on your server.
body:
**EnchantFlex** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows you to control the maximum levels of enchantments on your server.

It lets server owners easily customize enchantment limits through a simple configuration file without modifying the game itself.

The plugin is optimized and works smoothly on Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers.


> 
> Features
> 
> ⚙ Configure maximum enchantment levels
> 
> 📄 Simple and easy-to-edit configuration file
> 
> 🧩 Supports all vanilla enchantments
> 
> 🔧 Automatically supports both modern and legacy enchantment names
> 
> 🚀 Lightweight and optimized

Example

You can set custom enchantment limits such as:

```
Sharpness 8
Protection 10
Efficiency 10
Unbreaking 5

```

**Configuration**

```
config.yml
```

**Global maximum level**

```
default-max-level: 100
```

If an enchantment is not listed, this value will be used as its maximum level.
